notes.title: Battle Craft: Discover the mechanics of patrolling!
notes.content:
Welcome, dear players!

Today, we want to share with you one of the exciting features of our game - the settlement patrolling mechanic. In Battle Craft, each of your heroes can be equipped with a unique patrolling route, 
adding an additional level of strategy and tactics to the game.

What is it?
The patrolling mechanic allows you to set patrolling points for each character in your settlement. You can assign from 2 to 5 points for each hero, 
providing optimal coverage of the territory and protection against external threats.

How does it work?
Select the hero for whom you want to set the patrolling route, and simply mark the desired points on the map of your settlement. 
The hero will automatically move between these points, monitoring the surroundings and reacting to any threats.

Why is it important?
The patrolling mechanic allows you to effectively ensure the safety of your settlement, reduce the risks of enemy attacks, and optimize the work of your heroes. 
Additionally, it's a great way to enhance immersion and depth in the game world.

Don't miss the chance to take advantage of this unique opportunity in Battle Craft and provide your settlement with maximum protection and prosperity!

notes.title: Introducing the Basics of Control in Battle Craft
notes.content:
The Battle Craft team is delighted to present to you the fundamental control elements in our thrilling game! We want you to feel as comfortable as possible in the world of battles and strategy. Let's take a look at the main keys and commands that will help you succeed in our game:

Key [Q] - Rotate the camera to the left
Key [W] - Move the camera forward
Key [E] - Rotate the camera to the right
Key [R] - Rotate buildings (for strategic maneuvers)
Key [D] - Move the camera to the right
Key [S] - Move the camera backward
Key [A] - Move the camera to the left
The mouse wheel allows you to smoothly zoom in on the camera, getting closer to the battle details or zoom out to get an overview of the entire environment.
And if you need some time to rest or make adjustments, don't forget the [Esc] button. It opens the pause menu, where you can take a short break or exit the game.

We hope that these commands will help you fully immerse yourself in the world of Battle Craft and achieve great victories. Get ready for exciting battles and epic strategic maneuvers!
